title: Mediator activation-domain–Tail analysis: processed data and code
description: Version 1.0.0 provides frozen processed source data, dataset manifests, and deterministic Python validation, summary, and plotting code supporting quantitative analyses of activation-domain engagement with the human Mediator Tail in the accompanying Mediator manuscript. The release uses processed inputs, excludes AF3 atomic coordinates and upstream structural-analysis code, and does not reproduce manual structural panels. Code is licensed under MIT; processed data and documentation are licensed under CC BY 4.0.
